test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option in which the pair of letter-clusters share the same relationship as that shared by the given letter-clusters.

RS : IH
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic followed here is:

The letter form is the Opposite letter of the given letter cluster .

R(18) → I(9) 

S(19) → H(8)

By checking the options,

**1. TM : GN**

**T(20) → G(7)**

**M(13) → N(14) **

**This follows the pattern.**

2. BX : CY

B(2) → C(3)

X(24) → Y(25)

This doesn't follow the pattern.

3. RS : IT

R(18) → I(9)

S(19) → T(20)

This doesn't follow the pattern.

4. AJ : ZK

A(1) → Z(26)

J(10) → K(11)

This doesn't follow the pattern.

 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1**.
